notes: Discovery: robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Only Christmas (kerst*), Pasen (Easter) and Valentijnscadeaus (Valentine's) slugs exist; no Halloween/Sinterklaas/Diwali/other-festival category pages exist anywhere in nav or sitemap. Verified via live browser render (not just SSR fallback numbers, which proved unreliable): /collections/pasen and /collections/valentijnscadeaus both render a genuine 0-product empty PLP ('no products found') despite their SSR placeholder showing bogus large counts (17584 and 14164 respectively - these are stale/default values, not real; live page is blank) - both dropped as 0-qty per the zero-product rule, not extracted. Also confirmed 5 Christmas sub-slugs (kerstbomen, kerstboomverlichting, kerstdorp, kerstverlichting, kunstkerstboom) are genuinely 0 products right now (live-verified kerstboomverlichting shows 'Er komen geen producten overeen met de selectie'); dropped, not written as zero rows, per the shared zero-product rule. Site search discrimination check confirms search engine works correctly (returns 0 results for 'diwali', a real 1-item incidental hit for 'halloween' [a Le Creuset baking mold, not a category], and only blog articles for 'sinterklaas', no product category for any) - no Halloween/Sinterklaas/Diwali/other festival categories exist on this site at all; recorded as absent after real investigation (sitemap scan + nav mega-menu check under Woonaccessoires + search discrimination), not assumed. 'Kerst' (Christmas, 137) and 'Kerst woondecoratie' (Christmas Home Decor, 136) are near-total overlapping sets (live facet breakdown identical except Kerst has one extra 'Opbergzak'/storage-bag item) but not identical count+facets, so both kept as separate genuine site-taxonomy rows per the overlap rule (not merged). 'Kerstballen & Ornamenten' (73) = exact sum of the 'Kerstballen'(33)+'Kerstornament'(40) facets inside 'Kerst'; 'Kerstdecoratie' (58) = exact match of the 'Kerstdecoratie' facet inside 'Kerst' - both are the site's own distinct named PLP categories with their own URLs, kept as separate valid rows (not merged into the parent, since 'Kerst' is itself a real leaf PLP with its own 137 products, not a pure grouping node). Excluded /pages/kerst as a pure marketing/editorial landing page (blog-style copy referencing '2025', no product grid, no qty). None of the extracted Christmas categories qualify as pure grouping/parent nodes (is_group) - no nav tree was found presenting one as parent of the others; each is an independently named PLP with its own product count.
